plan.major: Business Administration, Concentration in Project Management
plan.notes: QUARTER CREDITS. Source: Academy College 2025-2027 Catalog (34th edition, effective July 7, 2025), BS Business Administration Concentration in Project Management program outline (BSBAPM). DISCLOSURE: the catalog header states a 180 quarter-credit minimum, but the catalog's own section minimums sum to 183 quarter credits (Accounting 6 + Business Courses 54 + Technical Electives 36 + CF2090 6 + PM Concentration 36 + General Education 45); the transcribed sum (183) is used here per the honest-transcription rule. The catalog outline is not semester-sequenced; sections below use the catalog's own section names. Per-course prerequisites are not published in the program outline (prereq left empty; see course descriptions in catalog for details). Elective blocks are modeled as single choice slots at the catalog's stated block-credit value. QUARTER MODELING NOTE: the catalog publishes program outlines by curriculum section, not a term-by-term map. The 12 quarters above are an editorial distribution of all catalog-listed courses/sections (~15.2 quarter credits each); confirm sequencing with an advisor. All credits are QUARTER credits.
